title: Snow Days season party (Cuenca Invernal / Wintery Basin)
names_seen: Snow Days season party (Cuenca Invernal / Wintery Basin)

facts.statement: A community event called the Snow Days season party was held at the Cuenca Invernal, a fishing area on a frozen lake, described as the first party of the Snow Days season.
facts.quote: Es la primera fiesta de la temporada de Días de Nieve!

facts.statement: The Americas session was on Thursday 9 December 2010 at 15:00 Pacific time, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 9 de Diciembre del 2010 15:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was on Friday 10 December 2010 at 09:00 Pacific time (16:00 GMT), on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 10 de Diciembre del 2010 09:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 hrs. GMT (Reino Unido y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: Players were invited to wear winter outfits and season costumes and bring a boombox to the party; the event was a fishing-area gathering on the frozen lake.
facts.quote: Viste los atuendos invernales, luce los disfraces de la temporada y trae tu radio casetera.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Temporada Cuenca Invernal (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice announcing the first Snow Days season party at the Cuenca Invernal (Wintery Basin) fishing area, a frozen lake. It gives the event dates and times for Server 1 by region and asks players to wear winter or seasonal outfits and bring a boombox. The page is a Wayback copy captured in June 2011.
